keyFindings.description: Line 35 tells the architect to link a child to each child it depends on with `dispatch issue-update --issue <child> --blocked-by <other>`, one call per dependency. Dispatch replaces the whole list on every call (dispatch issue-update --help: 'Replacement list of issue keys'; packages/envoy/internal/dispatch/api/issue_parent.go:335 deletes every blocked_by row before inserting the new targets). A child that depends on A and B ends up blocked by B alone, and StartUnblockedChildren starts it when B closes while A is still open. Fix: one call naming every issue it waits on (`--blocked-by <a> --blocked-by <b>`, the list replacing the old one), or the links at creation with `dispatch issue --blocked-by`; and reconcile the two older procedures that still say to wait and release by hand: decomposition.md:58-61 (a dependency on another repository's change is released only after its merge, naming the merged commit, which a held child that starts at the close cannot get) and wake-routing.md:29 ('released with release_children once this issue closes'). Same text in packages/claude-envoy/legion/.

The architect's required change. Line 36's park guidance (and the child-closed row of wake-routing.md) does not say that a child parked with park_child (backlog: stopped, not finished) leaves every sibling --blocked-by it held at admitted with no notice; the architect finds out only from SIGNOFF_CHILD_IN_WORKFLOW or read_record. Add: when you park a child, take its --blocked-by link off each dependent sibling that should still run, or park that sibling too. Within the skill size guard; same text in packages/claude-envoy/legion/.
